prompt: Nuxt 4 Cloudflare Pages functions directory ENOENT debugging discussion

assertions.name: follows-section7-template
assertions.description: Article uses TL;DR / Background / Problem / Investigation / Solution / My Take / Result / Lessons Learned structure (H2 headings)

assertions.name: frontmatter-complete
assertions.description: Frontmatter has: title, description, date, category, readTime, tags, seo.title, seo.description, relatedPosts

assertions.name: valid-category
assertions.description: category is one of 6 valid slugs

assertions.name: tags-from-closed-set
assertions.description: All tags come from the 50-tag closed set

assertions.name: seo-title-different
assertions.description: seo.title differs from post title (not identical)

assertions.name: image-proper-syntax
assertions.description: Body images use valid ![alt](url) markdown syntax

assertions.name: investigation-includes-wrong-turn
assertions.description: Investigation section mentions at least one misdiagnosis or wrong turn

assertions.name: specific-numbers
assertions.description: Body includes concrete numbers (time, performance, etc.) not vague quantifiers
